card.name: Section names in cross-references
card.fires_on: The last part of a section title inside a cross-reference such as "(see CLINICAL TRIALS" or "[see Clinical Studies". It fires on the closing piece of the title, where a section number or comma comes next.

modes.label: Capitalized title endings
modes.description: Final piece of an all-caps section name in a "see ..." pointer.

modes.label: Bracketed or numbered references
modes.description: Section title in a "[see Clinical Studies (14.5)]" style pointer or a named subsection reference.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like section, paragraph and footnote that label a cross-referenced part of the document.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label's text points the reader to another named section.
